newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Internet porn pedlar gets suspended jail term in HK.
newsitem.headline: Internet porn pedlar gets suspended jail term in HK.

text.p: Hong Kong's first convicted Internet pornography pedlar was given a suspended jail sentence for distributing obscene electronic pictures over the global communications network, a High Court official said on Friday.
A 24-year-old computer programmer, Lui Kin-wah, received a two-year suspended sentence in the British colony on Thursday.
More than 1,500 pornographic pictures had been seized from him by police when he was caught peddling porn on his Hong Kong- based Internet WorldWide Web site.
The pictures showed a range of sexual acts, including adults and animals having intercourse, and children and adults engaged in sexual acts, the court official said.
The porn site, "Cool as Joey", was discovered by an off-duty policeman who reported it to the Commercial Crime Bureau.
Lui told the court he was not selling the material, but a tag-line on his site asked users to send cash to his bank account if they stayed on line for more than 20 minutes.
Hong Kong has been moving to crack down on Internet abuses such as copyright piracy and pornography, along with child porn.
It is set to be the first place in Asia to ban possession of obscene material involving children. Laws being considered could see people fined or jailed for reading child porn.
In the first case of a web site being shut down in Asia, a Hong Kong site was forced to close last month after it was found to be offering pirated CD-ROM software for sale.
